gogLoginCode.description: The code you received after logging in (consult the README.md for more information). Be fast, this code is only valid for one minute. If you don't start the script within that time, it will not be able to generate an access token from it. Provide it via --gog-login-code or when prompted - storing it here is no longer allowed and the tool will refuse to run if it is set.

refreshToken.description: If you have used the script before and have a refresh token, provide it to avoid having to log in again to generate a login code. After a run, the refresh token is displayed once so you can set it as the GOG_REFRESH_TOKEN environment variable (or pass it with --refresh-token) next time. Provide the token via the GOG_REFRESH_TOKEN environment variable - storing it here is no longer allowed and the tool will refuse to run if it is set.
